criteria.text: OpencodeClientService.listCommands() returns [] when isReady is false (client is null).
criteria.test_id: issue-631-c1: listCommands returns [] when not ready

criteria.text: OpencodeClientService.listCommands() calls this.client.command.list() and maps each Command to {name, description}, dropping all other fields.
criteria.test_id: issue-631-c2: listCommands maps SDK commands to {name, description}

criteria.text: OpencodeClientService.listCommands() returns [] when this.client.command.list() throws an error (resilient — never propagates exceptions).
criteria.test_id: issue-631-c3: listCommands returns [] on SDK error

criteria.text: GET /opencode/commands route calls opencodeClient.listCommands() and returns the mapped array (not the hard-coded []).
criteria.test_id: issue-631-c4: GET /opencode/commands returns commands from SDK

criteria.text: Typing '/' in the composer shows the real list of user-defined commands (requires the SDK running with commands configured).
criteria.reason: Requires a running flutter app with the opencode SDK initialized and at least one user command defined in opencode.json. Not automatable in vitest.
